name: Gaming Desktop Profile
description: One switch for a game-ready desktop: Game Mode on, high performance power plan and fewer animations.
author: AETHER

compatibility.notes: This profile changes settings, not your hardware. It makes no frame-rate promises; benefits depend on the game and PC.

documentation.whatItChanges: HKCU\Software\Microsoft\GameBar\AutoGameModeEnabled, the active power plan (powercfg /setactive) and animation flags.
documentation.uninstall: Your previous power plan, Game Mode setting and animations are restored.
